mapper.select: SELECT murs.mb_request_shop, 'true' as isShop, ca.SHOP_TYPE, ca.SHOP_ID, mur.user_code FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST_SHOP murs, MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN CBCI_ACCOUNT ca ON ca.USER_CODE = mur.user_code WHERE mur.mbid = #{mbid} AND mur.mbid = murs.mbid AND (SELECT CC.CODE_E_NM FROM CBCI_CODE CC WHERE CC.CODE_ID = ca.SHOP_TYPE) = murs.mb_request_shop GROUP BY murs.mb_request_shop

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(입금계좌, ' ',-1) AS acc_no, SUBSTRING_INDEX(입금계좌, ' ', 1) AS acc_bank, '' as acc_holder FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_WITHDRAW_VALUE WHERE 입금계좌 IS NOT NULL AND SHOP_ID IN (${shop_id}) AND INPUT_TIME >= #{request_date} ORDER BY INPUT_TIME DESC

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(bank_account, '*', 1) AS acc_no, bank_name AS acc_bank, bank_account_holder AS acc_holder FROM CBCI_COUPANG_SETTLEMENT WHERE bank_account IS NOT NULL AND SHOP_ID IN (${shop_id}) AND input_date >= #{request_date} ORDER BY input_date DESC

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(계좌번호, ' ', -1), '*', 1) AS acc_no, SUBSTRING_INDEX(계좌번호, ' ', 1) AS acc_bank, '' AS acc_holder, 'naver' AS shop, SUB_STORE FROM CBCI_NAVER_WITHDRAWDAY WHERE 계좌번호 != '' AND SHOP_ID IN (${shop_id}) AND (SUB_STORE, INPUT_DATETIME) IN (SELECT SUB_STORE, MAX(INPUT_DATETIME) AS INPUT_DATETIME FROM CBCI_NAVER_WITHDRAWDAY GROUP BY SUB_STORE) AND INPUT_DATETIME >= #{request_date} GROUP BY SUB_STORE ORDER BY INPUT_DATETIME DESC

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(입금계좌번호, '*',-1) AS acc_no, 입금은행 AS acc_bank, 예금주명 AS acc_holder FROM CBCI_GMARKET_WITHDRAW WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${shop_id}) AND INPUT_DATETIME >= #{request_date} ORDER BY INPUT_DATETIME DESC

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(입금계좌번호, '*', 1) AS acc_no, SUBSTRING_INDEX(입금계좌번호, '*', -1) AS acc_second, 입금은행 AS acc_bank, 예금주명 AS acc_holder FROM CBCI_AUCTION_WITHDRAW WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${shop_id}) AND INPUT_DATETIME >= #{request_date} GROUP BY acc_first, acc_second ORDER BY INPUT_DATETIME DESC
SELECT DISTINCT 계좌번호 AS acc_no, 은행명 AS acc_bank, 예금주명 AS acc_holder FROM CBCI_11ST_WITHDRAW WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${shop_id}) AND INPUT_DATETIME >= #{request_date} ORDER BY INPUT_DATETIME DESC
